newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down in a subdued market.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down in a subdued market.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down nearly three percent on Thursday in yet another low-volume session as investors worried by bearish sentiment sold ahead of the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 90.75 points or 2.9 percent at 3,033.36. Of 94 traded issues, 67 lost, 26 gained and two unchanged. Turnover was 26.3 million taka.
All sectors except for financial scrips were hit, brokers said.
Beximco Pharma lost 20.76 taka to 394.54 and National Bank gained 15.85 to 332.92. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
